column1: # units.tsv — TEST-UNIT REGISTRY (build-rig only). BENCH-PROVISIONAL-SCORING (#20).
# One row per benchmark test unit = a section (S0-S6) OR a replayed red (#25).
# A unit is `provisional` while it COLLECTS data but has not yet proven it
# discriminates, and `active` once benchmark/promote.py's promotion gate flips
# it (score_spread >= SPREAD_MIN AND distinct_models >= K). bench.sh reads a
# unit's current stage from here and tags every scorecard row it appends with
# it (CHARON_SCORECARD_STAGE); capability/grades.py + tier_chart.py +
# model-scorecard.sh render then EXCLUDE provisional rows from live grades.
# TAB-separated. Columns: unit_id  kind(section|red)  stage(provisional|active)  promoted_on(YYYY-MM-DD or -)
# S0-S6 are the pre-existing synthetic sections, grandfathered `active` (they
# predate the gate — legacy defaults to active, and they only ever emit
# source=bench rows which the real-outcomes pivot already excludes from grades
# regardless of stage; their stage matters only if a future run re-tags them).
# NEW units (reds-replay per #25, harder sections per #17) MUST be added here
# as `provisional` and earn `active` through promote.py.
